sentences.text: This petition is filed by petitioners/accused Nos.1 to 3 under Section 482 of the Cr.P.C for quashing the FIR and complaint in crime No.87/2022 registered by East Zone Women police, Bengaluru City for the offence punishable under Sections 498A, 323, 504, 506 read with Section 34 of I.P.C and Section 3 and 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act, 1961 and under Section 66(E) of Information Technology Act.

entities.text: East Zone Women police, Bengaluru City
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: During the pendency of the petition, both petitioner and respondent No.2 appeared through their counsels and filed a joint compromise application along with affidavit under Section 320 read with Section 482 of I.P.C for seeking permission to compound the offence.

It is submitted that parties have settled their dispute in the matrimonial case, and Section 13(b) of the Hindu Marriage Act has been filed for consent divorce, and they said to exchange all the articles.
Submissions of the parties and both counsel are placed on record

In view of the judgment rendered by the Hon'ble Apex Court in Gian Singh vs State of Punjab and another (2012) 10 SCC 303, the parties are settled their issues and the Court can quash the criminal proceedings.

entities.text: Gian Singh vs State of Punjab and another (2012) 10 SCC 303
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
Accordingly,
I.A.No.1/2023 is allowed.
Parties are permitted to compound the offences.
Consequently, criminal petition is allowed.
The criminal proceedings against petitioner Nos.1 to 3 in crime No.87/2022 registered by East Zone Women police, Bengaluru City is hereby quashed.
